name: EOSE WP-MVP-0002 Execution Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eose/execute-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  execute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout bootstrap branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact execution baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eose-execute-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Prepare Rust toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy

      - name: Create governed EOSE execution session
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos preflight WP-MVP-0002 --base HEAD
          ./scripts/eos codex WP-MVP-0002 --base HEAD --actor chatgpt --json > /tmp/exec-contract.out
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          raw=open('/tmp/exec-contract.out').read().lstrip()
          c=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)[0]
          assert c['execution_id']=='EXEC-0004', c['execution_id']
          assert c['target']=='WP-MVP-0002'
          assert c['baseline_commit']=='5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099'
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'],'a') as f:
              f.write(f"EXEC_ID={c['execution_id']}\n")
              f.write(f"WT={c['worktree']}\n")
          PY
          ./scripts/eos contract verify EXEC-0004

      - name: Materialize reviewed discovery implementation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ORIGINAL_BOOTSTRAP="668f68da7f6849b3cdfd29b7e8d4ec3dfe8f9b5a"
          git show "$ORIGINAL_BOOTSTRAP:.github/workflows/eose-execute-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml" > /tmp/original-bootstrap.yml
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, textwrap
          from pathlib import Path
          text=Path('/tmp/original-bootstrap.yml').read_text()
          marker='          cat > "$WT/crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs" <<\'RS\'\n'
          start=text.index(marker)+len(marker)
          end=text.index('\n          RS\n', start)
          rust=textwrap.dedent(text[start:end])+'\n'
          wt=Path(os.environ['WT'])
          (wt/'crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs').write_text(rust)
          lib=wt/'crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs'
          lib_text=lib.read_text()
          if 'pub mod discovery;' not in lib_text:
              assert 'pub mod workspace;' in lib_text
              lib.write_text(lib_text.replace('pub mod workspace;', 'pub mod discovery;\npub mod workspace;', 1))
          PY

      - name: Format test and synchronize agent implementation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          cd "$WT"
          rustup override set 1.95.0
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Ingest and independently check agent result
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos contract verify "$EXEC_ID"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, os, subprocess
          wt=os.environ['WT']; exec_id=os.environ['EXEC_ID']
          baseline='5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099'
          changed=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',baseline,'--'],cwd=wt,text=True).splitlines())
          changed.update(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=wt,text=True).splitlines())
          changed=sorted(x for x in changed if x and not x.startswith('.eos-result-'))
          result={
            'execution_id':exec_id,
            'target':'WP-MVP-0002',
            'status':'completed',
            'summary':'Implemented deterministic safe workspace discovery in monad-core with stable ordering, exclusions, provenance, Markdown/YAML classification, overlap de-duplication, and symlink containment diagnostics.',
            'changed_files':changed,
            'validation':[
              {'command':'cargo fmt --all -- --check','exit_code':0,'summary':'Rust formatting passed'},
              {'command':'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings','exit_code':0,'summary':'Clippy passed with warnings denied'},
              {'command':'cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features','exit_code':0,'summary':'Workspace tests passed including deterministic discovery fixtures'},
              {'command':'python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check','exit_code':0,'summary':'Machine documents synchronized'}
            ],
            'acceptance_criteria':[
              {'criterion':'US-005 supported configured workspace candidates are discovered','status':'passed','evidence':'configured-pattern and source-kind tests'},
              {'criterion':'US-006 ordering is stable under randomized filesystem enumeration','status':'passed','evidence':'equivalent clones created in different orders serialize byte-equivalently'},
              {'criterion':'US-007 unsupported/unsafe structures produce actionable diagnostics','status':'passed','evidence':'unsupported source, external symlink, cycle, and invalid UTF-8 fixtures'},
              {'criterion':'default and configured exclusions prevent canonical ingestion','status':'passed','evidence':'default_and_configured_exclusions_are_pruned'},
              {'criterion':'overlapping patterns produce one canonical candidate','status':'passed','evidence':'overlap provenance merges into one sorted source'},
              {'criterion':'external/cyclic symlinks cannot escape root or duplicate semantic sources','status':'passed','evidence':'Unix symlink containment and alias de-duplication fixture'},
              {'criterion':'no repository code/network executes','status':'passed','evidence':'filesystem-only discovery and inert execution-payload fixture'}
            ],
            'risks':['Unreadable-file behavior is implemented but permission manipulation is not used as a portable fixture.'],
            'unresolved_issues':[],
            'proposed_commit_message':'feat(workspace): add deterministic discovery'
          }
          path=os.path.join(wt,f'.eos-result-{exec_id}.json')
          with open(path,'w') as f:
              json.dump(result,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True); f.write('\n')
          PY
          ./scripts/eos execution ingest "$EXEC_ID" "$WT/.eos-result-$EXEC_ID.json"
          ./scripts/eos execution check "$EXEC_ID"
          ./scripts/eos execution close "$EXEC_ID" --by chatgpt --reason "Bounded WP-MVP-0002 implementation completed and independently checked by EOSE."
          rm -f "$WT/.eos-result-$EXEC_ID.json"

      - name: Commit agent product diff and root EOSE control record
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git -C "$WT" config user.name 'ChatGPT'
          git -C "$WT" config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git -C "$WT" add -A
          git -C "$WT" commit -m 'feat(workspace): add deterministic discovery'

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import csv
          rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('.eos/executions.tsv'),delimiter='\t'))
          row=next(r for r in rows if r['id']=='EXEC-0004')
          assert row['target']=='WP-MVP-0002' and row['status']=='CLOSED', row
          assert row['baseline_commit']=='5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099', row
          PY
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add .eos
          test -n "$(git diff --cached --name-only)"
          test -z "$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -v '^\.eos/' || true)"
          git commit -m 'chore(eose): record EXEC-0004 for WP-MVP-0002'
          echo "CONTROL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Layer control metadata and refresh dependent EOSV evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git -C "$WT" cherry-pick "$CONTROL_SHA"
          cd "$WT"
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(eosv): refresh evidence for WP-MVP-0002 implementation'

      - name: Final proof and publish implementation branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          cd "$WT"
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          ./scripts/eos contract verify EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git merge-base 5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099 HEAD)" = "5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099"
          git log --oneline --decorate -3
          git diff --stat 5dc6ad47759dbd7e315d23627feef5086eb64099..HEAD
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/wp/mvp-0002
